(let c
  (lambda n
    (lambda k
      (if (eq n 1)
          k
          (if (eq (mod n 2) 1)
              (c (merge (mul 3 n) 1) (merge k 1))
              (c (div n 2) (merge k 1))))))
  (c 27 0))

(let f
  (lambda a
    (lambda b
      (lambda n
        (if (eq n 0)
            a
            (f b (merge a b) (sub n 1))))))
  (f 0 1 25))

(let isp
  (lambda n
    (if (lt n 2)
        0
        (if (eq (tau n) 2) 1 0)))
  (fold (lambda a (lambda x (merge a (isp x)))) 0 (range 0 50)))

(let isp
  (lambda n
    (if (lt n 2)
        0
        (if (eq (tau n) 2) 1 0)))
  (fold (lambda a (lambda x (if (isp x) (merge a x) a))) 0 (range 0 100)))

(let go
  (lambda xs
    (lambda prev
      (lambda cur
        (lambda best
          (if (nil? xs)
              (if (gt cur best) cur best)
              (if (eq (head xs) prev)
                  (go (tail xs) prev (merge cur 1) best)
                  (go (tail xs) (head xs) 1 (if (gt cur best) cur best))))))))
  (go "aaabbbbcca" (neg 1) 0 0))
